source.title: I care – Pflege
source.basis: Uploaded textbook only; no external clinical facts merged.

notes: P7 source signals were re-routed by PDF section position where possible.
Mass cards were deterministically reconstructed from source evidence and subjected to global mechanical/content-shape QA.
Items failing P7B gates are excluded from production rather than silently shipped.
Current-guidance modernization is not part of this source-faithful bank.
P9 reconstructs textbook section titles from PDF heading typography to repair multi-line truncation.
False figure-caption sections 28.9 and 59.16 were removed and their concepts re-routed.
Seven omitted real parent sections were reconstructed.
The synthetic 36.3–36.4 pilot section was removed; its concepts now live in the real 36.3/36.4 hierarchy.
P10 branding finalized as PflegeLern for repository /pflegelern and GitHub Pages release.
P13 expands the source-faithful application bank to 120 cases using conservative synthesized scenarios backed by certified 2015 textbook concepts.
P14 calibrates flashcard self-assessment without changing the three visible ratings or FSRS mapping.
P15 selectively offers optional free recall on direct-retrieval flashcards without automatic grading or direct FSRS changes.
P16 adds optional exam-horizon planning using only an exam date and scope without changing FSRS due dates.
P17 adds a bounded adaptive study mix while protecting due reviews and FSRS state.
P18 introduces Mastery Model v2 with separate evidence channels and conservative legacy migration.
P19 converts mistakes into bounded concept-level repair sequences with delayed transfer and spaced follow-up.
P20 upgrades Prüfung into Mock Exam System v2 with configurable scope, timer, balanced objective question selection, question overview and detailed results while preserving P16–P19 contracts.

P21 replaces the legacy visual layer with the Care Design System: high-contrast teal/mint healthcare branding, accessible light/dark palettes, stronger typography and hierarchy, elevated cards and forms, redesigned study/exam surfaces, five-tab mobile navigation, responsive layouts, and dedicated local backup/restore cards. Learning logic, content, storage schema and exam/remediation behavior are unchanged.
